verdicts.reason: A and B are almost pixel-identical; the only difference is that B's NEW and Try It pills sit about 5px lower. Both share the same flaws: the bottle cap touches the top edge and the cream circle is jammed into the top-left corner over a stray half-off-canvas ghost circle. The NEW badge is nearly as large as the Try It CTA and competes with it. The right-aligned buttons share no edge with the left-aligned headline, which leaves a dead bottom-left quadrant.
